title: Bounded Tape Transfer Run
statement: Let $k\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\mathrm{src}$ and $\mathrm{dst}$ be distinct indices among the $k$ work tapes, let $x$ be a Boolean input, and assign a Boolean word $w_i$ to each tape $i$, with $w_{\mathrm{dst}}$ empty. There is a natural number $T\leq 3|w_{\mathrm{src}}|+3$ such that the transfer machine, started in its sweep phase with these tape words, has not reached its done phase at any time $t<T$. At time $T$ it is in the done phase, with the source tape emptied and the original source word placed on the destination tape; all other tape words are unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ assigns a Boolean word to each of the $k$ tapes
the destination tape word is empty
